premises.text: Spinning up VMs, networking, and SSL for every app is tedious and error-prone even when building the app is easy
premises.evidence_span: I had to spin up VMs, install networking, set up SSL, and a ton of other things for every single app. It was tedious, it was error-prone

premises.text: Render deploys from static sites to complex clusters without managing servers, faster than other clouds
premises.evidence_span: you can do it faster than on any other cloud and without managing servers at all

premises.text: Native service discovery, private networking, load balancing, managed SSD backups, and single-file service definitions differentiate the managed cloud
premises.evidence_span: Render is the first fully managed cloud to offer SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores

premises.text: Pricing undercuts Heroku-like hosts while aiming at a large and growing PaaS then IaaS market
premises.evidence_span: Just two gigabytes of RAM costs $250 a month on Heroku compared to $25 a month on Render. So we truly give you the best of both worlds

value.text: Effortless automated cloud hosting with ease of use and flexibility

causal_links.evidence_span: Building these apps was easy. but hosting them was agonizing
I don't have to lift a finger for any of it
Amazing ease of use combined with tremendous flexibility
